title: KanbusKit
description:
Swift package implementing the Kanbus domain model and CLI, verified against the shared Gherkin behavior specs. KanbusKit is the Swift-native implementation of the same specifications that drive the Python (kanbus) and Rust (kbs) implementations. It produces a third set of step definitions against the shared features/ directory, achieving three-way spec parity.

The library exposes the full Kanbus domain -- issue CRUD, configuration loading, workflow transitions, queries, wiki, standup, right-now summaries -- as a Swift package. A CLI binary built on the library passes the same feature files with identical observable behavior: same JSON serialization, same error messages, same exit codes.

KanbusKit is also the foundation for Kanbus for Mac (the native SwiftUI console app). The domain model and business logic live here; UI is a separate initiative.
